|errata_history=This is the original printing (version 1 of 2) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current version; the current version is [[Padmé Naberrie (V) (ALT) (Errata)]] (PC-E1). The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V3-L-padmenaberrie_ai-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository (each image proves its text existed then; the errata may have been announced a few days later). Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-padmenaberrie_ai022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/padmenaberrie_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/padmenaberrie_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261113121305/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 Internet Archive primary-source copy].</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “•Padmé Naberrie”. Text: “Cancels Vader's game text here. If with a Skywalker, may add one destiny to attrition. Immune to attrition < 3.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Padmé Naberrie (V) (ALT) (Errata)]]): '''First published 27 November 2022''' as the high-resolution PNG <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/hires/padmenaberrie_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a75a24b55e5f97960ae23af599fb5f767e24e80c commit a75a24b]); the card-size image cited next is a later copy of the same image (a version is dated by its first publication in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). PC card image uploaded 1 December 2022<ref name="img-padmenaberrie_aieb53af7">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/padmenaberrie_ai.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/eb53af72c4491442a863d743950ff8a472ed77b3 commit eb53af7] (1 December 2022); the PC serves the same file at https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/Virtual3-Light/large/padmenaberrie_ai.gif (today's copy is the latest version only). The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref>. '''What changed:''' the bottom margin “•Padmé Naberrie” → “Padmé Naberrie” (uniqueness dot removed); the PC re-made the image at higher resolution (350×490 → 745×1039 pixels); the words of the game text are the same as the previous image. A visible change on the card, so it is its own version (Bill, 12 Nov 2026). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Padmé Naberrie”. It is the current image (the same file as the wiki's existing image). Text: “Cancels Vader's game text here. If with a Skywalker, may add one destiny to attrition. Immune to attrition < 3.”
